payload.description: Gives your Agents a voice that runs entirely on your PC, with no account and no per-use fee. Turns text into speech with Qwen3-TTS, a voice model that runs on your own graphics card. Nothing is sent to a cloud service and nothing is billed. It needs WSL 2 and an NVIDIA GPU, plus a download of about 3.4 GB. It speaks only; it does not listen.
